subject.title: feat: add Pioneer.ai as an inference provider with live model discovery

question: Should OpenClaw accept Pioneer as an official provider now, including this auth/default/publishing surface and the dependency graph changes in this PR?
rationale: The remaining blockers combine product ownership of a new official provider with supply-chain approval and user-facing provider/model-picker behavior, so automation should not choose the permanent provider policy.

options.title: Accept After Repair And Approval
options.body: Fix the custom-base-url catalog bug, get dependency graph approval or maintainer-regenerated metadata, then land Pioneer as an official provider.

options.title: Route To External ClawHub Package
options.body: Ask the contributor to publish Pioneer as a self-maintained ClawHub/npm provider and keep only generic missing API work in core.

options.title: Pause For Security Review
options.body: Hold the PR until a repository admin or secops reviewer explicitly authorizes the package, shrinkwrap, and publishing surfaces.

recommendation.title: Accept After Repair And Approval
recommendation.body: Fix the custom-base-url catalog bug, get dependency graph approval or maintainer-regenerated metadata, then land Pioneer as an official provider.

likelyOwner.reason: The open decision is official provider/product and package ownership rather than a narrow code repair, and Peter has broad adjacent history across provider plugin seams, package metadata, and TUI/Gateway model surfaces.
